About Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd

Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd, a subsidiary of Jio Platforms, is India’s largest telecommunications operator and a premier digital services provider. Known for revolutionizing the Indian telecom landscape, Jio builds enterprise-grade software applications, cloud architectures, and digital ecosystem platforms. Joining the IT & Systems team at Jio offers engineering freshers exposure to large-scale technological implementations and career progression.

Key Highlights of Jio SDE 1 Recruitment 2027

Vacancy & Role Details

Post Name: Software Development Engineer I

Department: IT & Systems

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and test software applications by writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

Maintain existing software applications according to dynamic project requirements.

Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy new system features.

Participate in peer code reviews to enforce software development standards and code quality.

Debug and troubleshoot technical software issues.

Assist technical writers in drafting user manuals and technical documentation.

Stay continuously updated with emerging industry technologies and software development practices.

Eligibility Criteria & Skill Requirements

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a B.Tech / B.E. degree.

Preference is given to specializations in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), or Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE).

Experience Level

0 to 3 Years: Entry-level developers and fresh engineering graduates are eligible.

Key Skills & Technical Competencies

Clear understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

Working knowledge of version control systems such as Git.

Basic familiarity with relational databases and SQL queries.

Fundamental understanding of software testing methods and debugging techniques.

Basic knowledge of front-end web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is considered a plus.

Strong problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt to dynamic enterprise stacks.

Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Salary, Stipend & Career Growth

Salary Package: As per industry standard for entry-level SDE 1 positions at Reliance Jio.

Benefits: Includes corporate health benefits, exposure to large-scale distributed systems, enterprise software tools, and long-term career advancement inside Reliance Jio’s tech hierarchy.
